meta.name: The Tire Plug — Applicant & Employee Scoring Rubric
meta.scale: Each trait scored 0–5. 0 = absent/red flag, 3 = meets bar, 5 = exceptional.
meta.philosophy: Character is the foundation and is trainable only through consequences, not coaching. Skill is teachable. Therefore character traits are weighted highest for any customer-facing role. 'Constructive' is rewarded over merely 'agreeable' — a yes-man who can't be honest about a car's condition is a liability, not an asset.

gates.label: Failed integrity / dishonesty
gates.description: Caught lying, theft, inventing work, or skimming. Touches cash, customer trust, and reputation. Auto-disqualify regardless of skill.

gates.label: Prior employer would not rehire
gates.description: Most predictive negative signal there is. Ask every reference: 'Would you rehire?'

gates.label: Lied on application
gates.description: Falsified certs, experience, or employment dates. If they lie to get in, they'll lie on the job.

gates.label: Documented no-call/no-show pattern
gates.description: At 20–30 cars/day one no-show backs up the whole bay. A pattern is disqualifying.

integrity.name: Integrity / Character
integrity.description: Tells the truth even when it costs them. Owns mistakes. Doesn't invent work or hide damage.
integrity.good: Flags their own error before you find it; recommends only needed work but never misses needed work.
integrity.bad: Covers up a scratched rim; oversells to hit a number; blames others.

team_contribution.name: Team Contribution
team_contribution.description: Actively makes the people around them better. Jumps in when the bay is slammed without being asked.
team_contribution.good: Helps the new tech, picks up slack, shares what they know.
team_contribution.bad: Stays in their lane while others drown; hoards knowledge; creates drama.

composure.name: Professionalism / Composure
composure.description: Keeps the inside of the shop off the customer floor. Stays constructive when there IS a problem instead of blowing up OR fake-smiling. This is the trait the 'foo' incident violated.
composure.good: Can be in a bad mood and still keep it off the floor; raises a real problem respectfully and privately.
composure.bad: Badmouths coworkers in the lobby; name-calls customers; OR never raises real problems just to keep the peace.

reliability.name: Reliability / Attendance
reliability.description: Shows up, on time, consistently. Single most predictive trait of long-term value.
reliability.good: Rock-solid attendance; gives notice; you can build the day around them.
reliability.bad: Frequent lateness; unreliable; vanishes on busy days.

communication.name: Communication
communication.description: Clear with customers and coworkers. Returns calls, follows up, translates findings into plain language.
communication.good: Explains the ball joint to the customer so the sale makes sense and they trust it.
communication.bad: Lets leads die; mumbles findings; no follow-up.

hustle_sales.name: Hustle / Sales Drive
hustle_sales.description: Moves with urgency; closes; makes the shop money — honestly.
hustle_sales.good: Recommends the alignment/road hazard because the car needs it; builds 10-year customers.
hustle_sales.bad: Slow, passive; OR pressure-sells one-time customers.

accuracy.name: Accuracy / Detail
accuracy.description: Right tire size, right service, right ticket. Wrong write-ups cause comebacks, refunds, reputation hits.
accuracy.good: Ticket matches the car every time.
accuracy.bad: Wrong size, wrong service, sloppy notes.

torque_safety.name: Torque & Safety Discipline
torque_safety.description: Proper torque specs every time. Under-torque is a lawsuit; over-torque is warped rotors and comebacks.
torque_safety.good: Specs every wheel, no shortcuts under time pressure.
torque_safety.bad: Eyeballs torque; cuts corners to move cars.

speed_quality.name: Speed Without Shortcuts
speed_quality.description: Fast, but car #25 gets the same quality as car #2. Stamina and pride through the day.
speed_quality.good: Consistent quality and pace at hour 9.
speed_quality.bad: Fast early, sloppy late; or shortcuts to fake speed.

equipment_care.name: Care With Wheels & Sensors
equipment_care.description: No scratched rims, no destroyed TPMS sensors. Sloppy hands = damage claims.

diagnostic.name: Diagnostic Ability
diagnostic.description: Reads wear patterns, understands suspension, finds the actual cause — not just 'set to spec and send it.'
diagnostic.good: Catches the bent control arm behind the bad alignment.
diagnostic.bad: Sets toe and ignores the real cause.

precision.name: Precision
precision.description: Hits spec, documents before/after, no 'close enough.'
precision.good: Before/after printout every time, dead on spec.
